# Common Music Notation (staff)

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:notationCMNStaff`](gmeow-notationCMNStaff.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/notationCMNStaff>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The Western five-line staff notation of letter names, accidentals, and octave numbers. A symbolic music notation; 12-EDO by default, with ad-hoc microtonal extensions.
